paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.66% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.93%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.19%). Brent crude changed -1.98% to 102.25. Gold changed -3.68% to 4,162.2998. Bitcoin changed +2.63% to 85,819.7266. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +1.79%. Among the firms tracked, Santander (-7.35%) and KKR (-6.60%) moved the most.
